faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about registering, paying and learning.

items.a: Tap Join free and enter your name, email, phone number and a password. Then ask to join a course and the Natik team accepts you.
Some courses are free and others have a price, shown on the course page in Ethiopian Birr (ETB). Every course needs the Natik team to accept you.

items.q: How do I pay for a course?
items.a: Pay by bank transfer or mobile wallet, or in cash at the centre. Then send us the payment reference. We check it and open your course.

items.q: How long until my course opens?
items.a: As soon as we confirm your payment. We check payments at least once every working day, and you get an SMS when your access is ready.

items.q: Can I study on my phone?
items.a: Yes. Natik works on any phone and loads quickly, even on slow connections.
PDFs and audio can be downloaded when the teacher allows it, so you can study offline. Videos can only be watched on the website.

Yes. Finish the course and pass the final quiz (the pass mark is 70%). You confirm the name for your certificate and the Natik team approves it. Then you can download it, and anyone can check it online with its number.

items.q: How long do I have access?
items.a: Each course shows its access period. When it ends, your results stay visible and we can renew your access.
Anyone aged 16 or older. For younger learners, please contact the centre and we will register them.

items.q: I forgot my password. What now?
items.a: Choose “Forgot password” on the sign-in page. We text a code to your phone so you can choose a new password.

items.q: Which language is the website in?
items.a: You can read the website in English, Amharic, Afaan Oromo or Somali: use the language button at the top. Course lessons are in Arabic, English or Afaan Oromo, and Arabic is shown right to left.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.subtitle: What we collect, why, and how we protect it.

p: Your name, email address, phone number and password (stored only as a secure hash). Optionally your photo, gender, country and city.
Your learning activity: lessons completed, quiz answers and results, and certificates.
Payment details you send us for a course: the method, reference, amount, date and an optional receipt photo. We never ask for card numbers, wallet PINs or bank passwords.
Messages you send through the contact form.
To run your account, give you access to your courses and show your progress.
To check payments and open or renew your access.
To send the few SMS messages the platform needs: password codes, account links, payment decisions and access reminders.
To issue certificates and let anyone verify them. A verification shows only your name, the course and the date.
Your teachers see your progress and results in their courses, but not your phone number or payments.
Natik staff see what they need to run the centre. We do not sell your data.
Trusted providers help us run the platform (hosting, SMS and video). They only handle data to provide their service.
We use one cookie to keep you signed in. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.
We keep your records while your account is active and for 3 years after your last activity. After that we remove your personal details.
Payment records are kept as tax rules require. Certificates are kept so they can always be verified.
You can edit your name, email and photo in your profile at any time.
You can ask us to delete your account. We handle requests within 30 days.
Students register themselves from age 16. Younger learners are registered by the centre.
Contact us any time and we will be glad to explain how your data is handled.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.subtitle: The simple rules for using Natik online.

p: You must be 16 or older to register yourself. Give accurate details and keep your password private.
You are responsible for what happens under your account. Tell us if you think someone else is using it.
Registering does not open any course. Ask to join a course and the Natik team accepts you. Paid courses also open after we confirm your payment.
Access lasts for the period shown on the course page. Courses are for your own personal learning.
You pay outside the website (bank, mobile wallet or cash) and send us the reference. A receipt photo alone does not open a course.
If something goes wrong with a payment, contact us and we will help put it right.
Videos, files and quizzes belong to Natik and its teachers. Please do not copy, share or resell them.
Where downloads are allowed, they are for your own study only.
Be respectful, and do not try to break or misuse the platform.
We may disable an account that breaks these rules.
A certificate is issued when you complete a course and pass its final quiz. We may cancel a certificate that was obtained unfairly.
We may update these terms and our courses from time to time. The date at the top shows when they last changed.

guides.a: Press Register, type your name, email, phone number and a password, accept the terms and press Create account. You are signed in straight away.

guides.q: How do I join a course?
guides.a: Open the course page and press "Request to join" (or "Pay and enrol" for a paid course). The Natik team checks every request and accepts you; you get an SMS, and every session of the course opens: videos, PDFs, slides and notes.

guides.q: How do I join a premium course?
guides.a: Premium courses are paid monthly. Message the Natik team on WhatsApp, Telegram or in the chat on this site. They explain the payment and open your course.

guides.q: How do lessons, slides and quizzes work?
guides.a: Each lesson has steps, such as slides, a video and practice. Press Next step to move on. A quiz marks itself and shows your score. Short written answers are marked by your teacher.

guides.q: How do I get my certificate?
guides.a: Finish every lesson and pass the final quiz. Your certificate appears under Certificates and can be downloaded as a PDF. Anyone can check it with its number.

guides.q: I forgot my password. What now?
guides.a: Press Sign in, then Forgot password. Enter your email and we text a code to the phone number on your account, so you can choose a new password.

guides.q: How can I talk to my teacher or the Natik team?
guides.a: Open Messages in your student area and start a chat. You can send text, pictures, files and voice messages.

guides.q: How do I use Natik on my phone?
guides.a: Natik works in your phone browser. In Chrome or Safari, use the Add to Home screen option to keep it like an app.

student.subtitle: Learn how to use Natik, from your first sign in to your certificate.
student.videoTitle: How to use Natik: a guide for students
student.videoText: This video shows the whole journey in a few minutes. You can also read the steps in the Written guide.

steps.title: Create your account and sign in
steps.text: Register with your name, email, phone number and a password. Next time, sign in with the same email and password. If you forget the password, use "Forgot password" and we send a code by text message.

steps.title: Find a course
steps.text: Open Explore to see the free and premium courses. Use the filters and the search box, or take the free level check to see where to start. Tap a course to read what you will learn and who the teacher is.

steps.title: Ask to join
steps.text: Tap "Request to join" on the course. The Natik team accepts you and we send you a text message. Premium courses also need a payment: pay in the way shown, send us the reference number, and we confirm it.

steps.title: Learn week by week
steps.text: Open the course from My courses. Each week has up to three sessions with a recorded video, a PDF, slides and notes. New sessions are marked "New". Open a session, watch, read, then tap "Mark as complete".

steps.title: Talk with your class
steps.text: Every course has a group chat in Course groups. Ask a question, send a photo, a voice message or a file, and help your classmates. Your teacher is in the group too.

steps.title: Take the quizzes
steps.text: Quizzes check what you learned. Answer all the questions and submit. Most are marked at once; written answers are marked by your teacher. The pass mark is shown before you start.

steps.title: Message the team and read the news
steps.text: Use Messages to write to the Natik team or your teacher. Announcements show news for everyone and for your courses. A small dot shows when there is something new.

steps.title: Get your certificate
steps.text: When you finish a course and pass the final quiz, confirm the name to print on your certificate. The Natik team checks it and sends it to you. You can download it as a PDF, and anyone can check it online with its number.

steps.title: Your account and language
steps.text: In Profile you can change your photo, name, country and password. Use the language button at the top to read Natik in English, Amharic, Afaan Oromo, Tigrigna or Somali.

teacher.subtitle: Learn how to run your course on Natik, from adding sessions to talking with students.
teacher.videoTitle: How to use Natik: a guide for teachers
teacher.videoText: This video shows how to add sessions, answer students and mark quizzes. You can also read the steps in the Written guide.

steps.title: Sign in and open your courses
steps.text: Sign in with your email and password. My courses lists the courses the Natik team has given you. Only an admin can create a course or change its price; you add the lessons.

steps.title: Add weeks and sessions
steps.text: Open a course and its Content tab. Add a week, then add up to three sessions in it. Give each session a title and a date. Courses grow week by week, so you add new sessions as the weeks go by.

steps.title: Put the material in each session
steps.text: Paste the YouTube link of your recorded lesson, attach a PDF, a PowerPoint or Word file, and write notes. Publish the session and your students get it at once, with a "New" mark and a message in the course group.

steps.title: Create quizzes
steps.text: Add a quiz to a session or to the end of the course. Choose the question types, the pass mark and the number of attempts. Publish it when it is ready.

steps.title: Mark written answers
steps.text: Marking lists the answers that wait for you. Read each one, give marks and write a short comment. The student sees the result and your comment.

steps.title: See your students
steps.text: In a course, the Students tab shows who is accepted and how far each person has got. Use it to find students who need a little help.

steps.title: Talk with the class
steps.text: Your course has a group chat. Answer questions, pin an important message, and remove anything that does not belong. Use Announcements to tell all your students something important.

steps.title: Certificates
steps.text: When a student finishes, they confirm their name and the Natik team approves the certificate. You do not need to do anything for that.

steps.title: Need help?
steps.text: Write to the Natik team in Messages at any time. Use the language button at the top to read Natik in your language.
